description: A script for computing and collecting interface information from IDL files, including handling partial interfaces, dependencies, and generating data structures for code generation.

classes.name: IdlBadFilenameError
classes.description: Exception raised when an IDL filename does not match the interface name in the file.

classes.name: InterfaceInfoCollector
classes.description: Class responsible for collecting interface information from IDL files, including handling partials, dependencies, and related metadata.

methods.name: parse_options
methods.description: Parses command-line options for the script.

methods.name: relative_dir_posix
methods.description: Calculates relative directory path in POSIX format.

methods.name: include_path
methods.description: Generates relative include path for header files.

methods.name: get_implements_from_definitions
methods.description: Retrieves left and right interface implementations from definitions.

methods.name: collect_union_types_from_definitions
methods.description: Collects all union types from definitions.

methods.name: collect_info
methods.description: Reads an IDL file and gathers interface-related information.

methods.name: get_info_as_dict
methods.description: Returns collected interface info as a dictionary.

methods.name: get_component_info_as_dict
methods.description: Returns component-wide info as a dictionary.
